name: Hoshinami Chihaya
source:
Grade: High school 2nd grader.
Room: Megae Dorm, Room 202.
Characteristic: Chihaya is very modest and shy. She prefers to interact with nature to having friends. Her hobby is traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
